name: Philips professional Wax Melting Machine for Hair Removal |  Model FJF508-1 | Electric Wax Warmer with 2 Aluminum Pots | Adjustable Temperature Control up to 80°C | 100W
description:
Achieve convenient and efficient wax heating at home or in a professional salon with the Philips Style Inspirations Wax Heater. Designed to warm different types of wax, this 100W electric wax warmer features adjustable temperature control, a heating indicator light, and removable aluminum containers for convenient wax preparation. The transparent cover helps prevent wax contamination while allowing easy visibility during heating. The removable containers make it convenient to heat wax directly, including 400g wax cans, making this wax heater suitable for regular hair removal and beauty care routines.

100W electric wax heater for efficient wax warming
Suitable for warming different types of wax
Includes 2 aluminum pots with plastic handles
Removable aluminum container for convenient use
Can accommodate 400g wax cans directly inside
Transparent see-through cover helps prevent wax contamination
Heating indicator light for convenient operation
Adjustable temperature regulator control knob
Maximum adjustable temperature up to 80°C
Removable metal bar for added convenience
Compact and practical design for home or salon use
Designed for convenient and controlled wax heating

How to Use
Place the wax into the appropriate aluminum container
For suitable 400g wax cans, place the can directly inside the heater
Connect the wax heater to a compatible 220–240V power supply
Adjust the temperature using the temperature regulator knob
Allow the wax to heat until it reaches the desired consistency
Use the heating indicator light to monitor the heating process
Always check the wax temperature before application

Safety Information
Read the product instructions before use
Use only with a compatible 220–240V power supply
Do not touch heated wax or metal components with bare hands
Always test wax temperature before applying to skin
Do not operate the appliance with damaged wires or components
Keep away from water and moisture
Keep out of reach of children
Allow the unit to cool completely before cleaning or storing
Do not leave the heater unattended while in operation
